global: Spicy ramen broth, vivid red and steaming, cradles noodles, bean sprouts, and onions. White bowl rests on wood, lit warmly, with spoon and chopsticks poised for eating.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle natural texture.

regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, bean sprouts, and onions, showing rich red color and glossy surface.
